name: reminders-list-all-reminders
description: List all reminders across all lists via AppleScript, showing list name, reminder name, due date, and completion status.

steps.script:
tell application "Reminders"
	set output to {}
	repeat with aList in lists
		set listName to name of aList
		repeat with r in reminders of aList
			set dueStr to ""
			if due date of r is not missing value then
				set dueStr to " (due: " & (due date of r as string) & ")"
			end if
			set completedStr to ""
			if completed of r is true then set completedStr to " [DONE]"
			set end of output to listName & ": " & name of r & dueStr & completedStr
		end repeat
	end repeat
	return output
end tell
steps.description: Returns a list of all reminders across all lists. Each entry includes list name, reminder name, due date (if set), and [DONE] if completed.
